purpose: Teach: 可動/一団/電通/テコ/使節/敷設/全貌/国内線

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、可動式バリケードを配備されますね
lines.en: So the police are deploying movable barricades.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Steady, conversational pace. Slight uptick at the end like he's confirming rather than questioning. Nodding along.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、暴徒一団の制圧訓練もされますね
lines.en: And they're running suppression drills for mob control too.
lines.style: Continuing the same tone. Adding pieces to a picture he's building. Casual, almost itemizing. No judgment, just noting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、電通系メディアとの広報連携もされますね
lines.en: They're coordinating their PR with Dentsu media as well, I hear.
lines.style: Still even-keeled. Light knowing quality — this is how these things work. Factual, slightly insider perspective without pretension.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査にテコ入れする方針ですね
lines.en: So the investigation strategy is to apply more pressure on it.
lines.style: Maintaining rhythm. Direct observation. Warm but measured, like he's thinking out loud with someone who understands the machinery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海外警察使節の警備もされますね
lines.en: And they're handling security for foreign police delegations.
lines.style: Adding another layer. Calm enumeration. His voice stays level — these are facts stacking up, and he's presenting them without spin.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯カメラの敷設を進められますね
lines.en: They're also rolling out more surveillance cameras across the city.
lines.style: Same steady pace. Almost methodical. No inflection of approval or concern, just the reality of expanding coverage.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪の全貌を市民に公表されますね
lines.en: And they're releasing the full picture of the crime to the public.
lines.style: A beat of quiet significance here. Slightly slower. The weight of transparency settling in. Still measured, but you hear the import.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、国内線テロ対策も担当されますね
lines.en: They're handling domestic flight security measures too, it seems.
lines.style: Wrapping up the inventory. Slightly closer, more intimate — like he's sharing something that touches him personally. Voice a hair lower.
